domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or mixed number into an equivalent form that makes part-by-part subtraction possible, such as adding a 0-fraction part, converting an improper fractional part to a standard mixed number, or separating whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/n before subtracting fraction parts.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is converted to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when a mixed number is explicitly rewritten as separate whole and fractional parts to set up subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the step only finds or applies a common denominator.
Do not tag when the step is borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has revealed a negative fractional difference.
Do not tag when the step only combines already-computed parts into the final answer.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite one or both fractional parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike denominators.
Tag when one or both fractions are rewritten as equivalent fractions with a shared denominator.
Tag when the solution explicitly performs a common-denominator step even if the denominator does not change one or both fractions.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no explicit conversion/alignment step is shown.
Do not tag for borrowing one whole and converting it to n/n during regrouping.
Do not tag for simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract whole-number parts and/or fractional parts once the quantities are in compatible form, including subtracting numerators over a shared denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers or rewritten whole numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solution subtracts whole and fraction parts separately after setup is complete.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the main action is creating equivalent fractions to align denominators.
Do not tag when the main action is borrowing/regrouping because the fractional difference is negative.
Do not tag when the step only simplifies or only recombines the final result.

skills.name: Regroup for subtraction
skills.definition: Borrow 1 from the whole-number part and convert it into fractional units when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract the subtrahend's fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the whole part is reduced by 1 and one whole is converted into n/n and added to the fractional part.
Tag when regrouping is used to replace a negative fractional difference with a subtractable positive one.
Tag whether the borrowed whole is written separately as n/n or immediately combined with the existing fraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction is completed directly without borrowing.
Do not tag for initial rewriting of a whole number as x + 0/n before any need to borrow is established.
Do not tag for final simplification or final answer formatting.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms or rewrite a zero-valued fraction as 0 after subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by a common factor after subtraction.
Tag when a result such as 0/n is rewritten as 0.
Tag when simplification is shown explicitly before the final answer is stated.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the result is already in lowest terms and no simplification step is shown.
Do not tag for finding equivalent fractions during common-denominator conversion.
Do not tag for combining whole and fractional parts if no reduction occurs.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number and fractional parts into the final answer form, including recognizing when the result should be written as a mixed number, pure fraction, integer, or 0.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are recombined into a mixed number.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted so the result is written as a pure fraction.
Tag when a zero fractional part or both zero parts are used to present an integer or 0.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the subtraction itself.
Do not tag for simplification of the fraction before recombination.
Do not tag when the final form is produced directly within a single subtraction statement and no recombination/presentation step is shown.
